item.title: Caddo Parish sheriff announces $1,000 college scholarship for graduating senior, apply by April 1
item.description: The Caddo Parish Sheriff’s Office announced the availability of a $1,000 college scholarship for a graduating high school senior in Caddo Parish. The scholarship is offered annually through the Louisiana Sheriffs’ Honorary Membership Program and is designed to help offset the costs associated with higher education.
